response.query: Which σ̂ estimators (OOB local residual variance, quantile‑regression forests, local neighbor scale) are consistent for local spread with RFs, and what are their runtime/memory tradeoffs and regularity conditions?
response.answer: OOB local residual variance and quantile-regression forests are consistent σ̂ estimators for local spread in RFs. OOB variance has higher memory usage, while quantile-regression forests have moderate runtime and memory tradeoffs. Regularity conditions include sufficient sample size and independence of residuals.
